info.title: Naijacloud API
info.description: The public REST API. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer nc_live_…` (create a key in the dashboard under Settings → API keys). Conventions — pagination, errors, idempotency, rate limits, versioning — are described at https://naijacloud.com/docs/api.

DeployTrigger.description: What started it: a push, a person, a rollback, …

DnsZoneVerificationMethod.description: How ownership of the domain was proven; null while pending.

DomainUnavailableReason.description: The same answer as a code. Branch on this, not on the sentence — the sentence is copy and will be reworded, and "somebody else has it" and "we cannot sell it yet" are opposite answers that look alike.

EnvVarScope.description: When the variable is available. Defaults to build and runtime.

EnvironmentKind.description: DEV, UAT or PROD when the name is exactly that tier (any case); null for a custom name such as "staging". The tier decides which scoped variables apply.

RepoScanStatus.description: Why a scan came back empty, when it did.

ServiceSuspension.description: Why nothing is running, if anything: NONE, USER (suspended by a person), BILLING or ABUSE.

tokenHint.description: The head of the key including its prefix, to identify it in a list.

tokenTail.description: Last characters of the key, to identify it against a value stored in a .env file or a CI secret. Null for keys issued before this was recorded.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

id.description: Plan id: free, pro or scale.

monthlyKobo.description: Monthly price in kobo. Accrues by the hour from the wallet (monthly ÷ 730), like a service.

includedErrors.description: Errors included each month before per-error pricing.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.
Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

policy.description: An S3 bucket policy document, as JSON text.

host.description: Host reachable from your other services.

password.description: Empty for a read-only role: it may see where the database is, not log in.

externalUrl.description: Public URL, when external access is on.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

name.description: 3–63 lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens; unique across Naijacloud.

region.description: Region key. New services in the project are placed there unless they name another.

tier.description: Instance size. FREE uses the workspace free slot.

sourceType.description: Optional: inferred from image, gitUrl or repoFullName when omitted.

schedule.description: CRON only: a five-field cron expression, in UTC.

command.description: CRON only: the command each run executes.

indexPath.description: The page to serve at "/" when it is not index.html.

spaFallback.description: Serve the index page for unknown paths (single-page apps).

environmentId.description: The environment to create the site in. Omitted, it lands in the workspace's static-sites project.

id.description: Plan id: launch, production, growth or team.

monthlyKobo.description: What the card is charged each month, in kobo. It all goes into the balance.

bonusKobo.description: Bonus credit added with each payment, in kobo (monthlyKobo × bonusPercent ÷ 100, rounded down).

spendKobo.description: What the customer gets to spend each month, in kobo: monthlyKobo + bonusKobo.

goodFor.description: One line for the plan card: what it typically covers.

seq.description: Run number for this job, from 1.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.
Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

lastCheck.description: What the last DNS check found.

ownershipVerifiedAt.description: When you proved you own the domain. Null until the ownership TXT record in dnsTarget.records is published; the domain does not route before then.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.
Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

statement.description: SQL (Postgres/MySQL/MariaDB) or a mongosh expression (MongoDB). Runs as the service's own database user, so it can write and drop as well as read.

trigger.description: What started it: a push, a person, a rollback, …

error.description: Why it failed, written for you.

durationMs.description: From the start of work (not queueing) to the end, in ms.

environmentId.description: Defaults to the project's production environment.

command.description: The command that deployed it, shown on the live version.

tier.description: Only used when this deploy creates the environment's functions runtime. Without it the runtime is Free while the workspace has its free runtime open.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

freeTier.description: Whether a Free-size service can run in this region. Free services run only where the platform's free capacity is; pick a paid size elsewhere.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.
Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

rootDir.description: The folder, "." for the repo root.

status.description: Why a scan came back empty, when it did.

workspace.description: Whether the repo is a workspace monorepo.

name.description: "@" for the zone apex, or a label.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

aRecord.description: A-record address, when an apex domain cannot use a CNAME.

conflicts.description: Existing records that block verification; remove them.

verificationMethod.description: How ownership of the domain was proven; null while pending.

verificationRecord.description: The TXT record that proves ownership while the zone is pending verification; null once ownership is proven.

verifiedAt.description: When ownership of the domain was proven. Null while the zone is pending verification: it is not published and its name is not yet exclusively held.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

host.description: Record name relative to the domain, e.g. _naijacloud-verify

value.description: The exact value the TXT record must hold.

amountKobo.description: What they will be charged, in kobo

checkoutUrl.description: The hosted payment page to send the customer to

reference.description: Our reference for the order; echoed back on payment

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

amountKobo.description: What the customer pays, in kobo. Firm — the checkout is created for exactly this amount.

expiresAt.description: The current expiry date, or null if we hold none

newExpiresAt.description: What the expiry becomes once paid. Extends the current date rather than restarting from today, so renewing early loses nothing.

available.description: What they asked for and can have, cheapest first

availableCount.description: How many rows across all groups can be bought

query.description: The bare name searched, after stripping any URL

suggestions.description: Name variants they could have instead, cheapest first. Always available — a suggestion somebody else owns is not a suggestion.

unavailable.description: What they cannot have, each row carrying its own reason. Returned rather than dropped: somebody who typed a .ng needs to see why.

available.description: Whether this domain can be bought here, right now

premium.description: Premium names are priced individually by the registry and cost far more than the standard rate

priceKobo.description: What the customer pays, in kobo, for `years`. Firm, not an estimate — the checkout is created for exactly this amount, so the row, the payment page and the receipt agree. Null when it cannot be sold or cannot be priced right now.

unavailableCode.description: The same answer as a code. Branch on this, not on the sentence — the sentence is copy and will be reworded, and "somebody else has it" and "we cannot sell it yet" are opposite answers that look alike.

unavailableReason.description: Why it cannot be bought, in words meant for the customer

years.description: Years the price covers — some registries only allow one

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

value.description: Blanked for read-only roles. Linked values are read-only.

linked.description: Linked in from a sibling database's connection string; change it there.

needsRedeploy.description: True when a redeploy is needed for the change to apply.

scope.description: When the variable is available. Defaults to build and runtime.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last.

isPreview.description: True for a pull-request preview environment.

paused.description: True while this environment is paused on its own. A paused project stops it too without setting this.

message.description: Written for you to read, or a generic sentence with a reference.

requestId.description: Equals the x-request-id response header. Quote it to support.
